user_bio: I’m Jan, founder of CloudHeads, a small automation and AI studio in Pafos, Cyprus. I build n8n workflows and AI agents for small businesses: phone receptionists that book appointments, meeting notes turned into follow-up emails, and leads that research themselves. Before this I spent 11 years as Director of Engineering at two luxury London hotels, after starting as an electrician. So I learn the process first, keep it simple, and tell you when something isn’t worth automating.
